description: This Java class 'PurgeEntitiesReason' defines a specific type of ShutdownReason used in the Eclipse Ditto project for purging entities within a namespace. It provides methods for creating instances from entity IDs or JSON, serializing to JSON, and checking relevance.

classes.name: PurgeEntitiesReason
classes.description: A final class representing a shutdown reason specific to purging entities, implementing the ShutdownReason interface. It holds a list of entity IDs to purge and provides JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and string representation methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of PurgeEntitiesReason from a list of EntityId objects representing entities to purge.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JsonObject to instantiate a PurgeEntitiesReason with entity IDs extracted from the JSON details.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of shutdown reason, which is PURGE_ENTITIES.

methods.name: isRelevantFor
methods.description: Checks if a given object (typically a string) matches any of the entity IDs to be purged.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the object into a JsonObject utilizing current schema version and predicate filters.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the object into a JsonObject with specific schema version and custom predicate.
